title: Claude CLI agent runtime
summary: External agent CLI used by DontPanic as an implementer, auditor, or goal-auditor runtime.

services: Claude account / Claude Code or CLI runtime

verify.readiness: Ready when the claude command is present and the selected DontPanic role points at claude.

mutation_boundary.allowed_path: DontPanic supervisor invokes claude through the governed executor and captures artifacts through audit/signoff writers.
forbidden: Untracked agent writes outside declared plan scope
Treating Claude account configuration as DontPanic-owned state

notes: Claude is an external runtime, not bundled by DontPanic.
Core profile may also support other agent CLIs; this manifest records the Claude-specific path.

setup_steps.what: Install the Claude CLI so DontPanic can spawn agent runs through the governed executor.
Authenticate the Claude CLI against the operator's Claude account or API key.
setup_steps.human_required_reason: Operator must approve scopes for their Claude account and treat the API token as a secret; DontPanic does not provision Claude credentials on the operator's behalf.
